   249→	baseTree, err := s.repo.TreeObject(baseTreeHash)
   250→	if err != nil {
   251→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to get base tree: %w", err)
   252→	}
   253→
   254→	entries := make(map[string]object.TreeEntry)
   255→	if err := FlattenTree(s.repo, baseTree, "", entries); err != nil {
   256→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to flatten tree: %w", err)
   257→	}
   258→
   259→	// Compute metadata paths
   260→	sessionMetadataDir := paths.EntireMetadataDir + "/" + opts.SessionID
   261→	taskMetadataDir := sessionMetadataDir + "/tasks/" + opts.ToolUseID
   262→
   263→	if opts.IsIncremental {
   264→		// Incremental checkpoint: only add the checkpoint file
   265→		// Use proper JSON marshaling to handle nil/empty IncrementalData correctly
   266→		incrementalCheckpoint := struct {
   267→			Type      string          `json:"type"`
   268→			ToolUseID string          `json:"tool_use_id"`
   269→			Timestamp time.Time       `json:"timestamp"`
   270→			Data      json.RawMessage `json:"data"`
   271→		}{
   272→			Type:      opts.IncrementalType,
   273→			ToolUseID: opts.ToolUseID,
   274→			Timestamp: time.Now().UTC(),
   275→			Data:      opts.IncrementalData,
   276→		}
   277→		cpData, err := json.MarshalIndent(incrementalCheckpoint, "", "  ")
   278→		if err != nil {
   279→			return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal incremental checkpoint: %w", err)
   280→		}
   281→
   282→		cpBlobHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, cpData)
   283→		if err != nil {
   284→			return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to create incremental checkpoint blob: %w", err)
   285→		}
   286→		cpFilename := fmt.Sprintf("%03d-%s.json", opts.IncrementalSequence, opts.ToolUseID)
   287→		cpPath := taskMetadataDir + "/checkpoints/" + cpFilename
   288→		entries[cpPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   289→			Name: cpPath,
   290→			Mode: filemode.Regular,
   291→			Hash: cpBlobHash,
   292→		}
   293→	} else {
   294→		// Final checkpoint: add transcripts and checkpoint.json
   295→
   296→		// Add session transcript
   297→		if opts.TranscriptPath != "" {
   298→			if transcriptContent, readErr := os.ReadFile(opts.TranscriptPath); readErr == nil {
   299→				if blobHash, blobErr := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, transcriptContent); blobErr == nil {
   300→					transcriptPath := sessionMetadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileName
   301→					entries[transcriptPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   302→						Name: transcriptPath,
   303→						Mode: filemode.Regular,
   304→						Hash: blobHash,
   305→					}
   306→				}
   307→			}
   308→		}
   309→
   310→		// Add subagent transcript if available
   311→		if opts.SubagentTranscriptPath != "" && opts.AgentID != "" {
   312→			if agentContent, readErr := os.ReadFile(opts.SubagentTranscriptPath); readErr == nil {
   313→				if blobHash, blobErr := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, agentContent); blobErr == nil {
   314→					agentPath := taskMetadataDir + "/agent-" + opts.AgentID + ".jsonl"
   315→					entries[agentPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   316→						Name: agentPath,
   317→						Mode: filemode.Regular,
   318→						Hash: blobHash,
   319→					}
   320→				}
   321→			}
   322→		}
   323→
   324→		// Add checkpoint.json
   325→		checkpointJSON := fmt.Sprintf(`{
   326→  "session_id": %q,
   327→  "tool_use_id": %q,
   328→  "checkpoint_uuid": %q,
   329→  "agent_id": %q
   330→}`, opts.SessionID, opts.ToolUseID, opts.CheckpointUUID, opts.AgentID)
   331→
   332→		blobHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, []byte(checkpointJSON))
   333→		if err != nil {
   334→			return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to create checkpoint blob: %w", err)
   335→		}
   336→		checkpointPath := taskMetadataDir + "/checkpoint.json"
   337→		entries[checkpointPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   338→			Name: checkpointPath,
   339→			Mode: filemode.Regular,
   340→			Hash: blobHash,
   341→		}
   342→	}
   343→
   344→	// Build new tree from entries
   345→	return BuildTreeFromEntries(s.repo, entries)
   346→}

   348→// ListTemporaryCheckpoints lists all checkpoint commits on a shadow branch.
   349→// This returns individual commits (rewind points), not just branch info.
   350→// The sessionID filter, if provided, limits results to commits from that session.
   351→func (s *GitStore) ListTemporaryCheckpoints(ctx context.Context, baseCommit string, sessionID string, limit int) ([]TemporaryCheckpointInfo, error) {
   352→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   353→
   354→	shadowBranchName := ShadowBranchNameForCommit(baseCommit)
   355→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   356→
   357→	ref, err := s.repo.Reference(refName, true)
   358→	if err != nil {
   359→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilerr // No shadow branch is expected case
   360→	}
   361→
   362→	iter, err := s.repo.Log(&git.LogOptions{From: ref.Hash()})
   363→	if err != nil {
   364→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit log: %w", err)
   365→	}
   366→
   367→	var results []TemporaryCheckpointInfo
   368→	count := 0
   369→
   370→	err = iter.ForEach(func(c *object.Commit) error {
   371→		if count >= limit*5 { // Scan more to allow for session filtering
   372→			return errStop
   373→		}
   374→		count++
   375→
   376→		// Verify commit belongs to target session via Entire-Session trailer
   377→		commitSessionID, hasTrailer := paths.ParseSessionTrailer(c.Message)
   378→		if !hasTrailer {
   379→			return nil // Skip commits without session trailer
   380→		}
   381→		if sessionID != "" && commitSessionID != sessionID {
   382→			return nil // Skip commits from other sessions
   383→		}
   384→
   385→		// Get first line of message
   386→		message := c.Message
   387→		if idx := strings.Index(message, "\n"); idx > 0 {
   388→			message = message[:idx]
   389→		}
   390→
   391→		info := TemporaryCheckpointInfo{
   392→			CommitHash: c.Hash,
   393→			Message:    message,
   394→			SessionID:  commitSessionID,
   395→			Timestamp:  c.Author.When,
   396→		}
   397→
   398→		// Check for task checkpoint first
   399→		taskMetadataDir, foundTask := paths.ParseTaskMetadataTrailer(c.Message)
   400→		if foundTask {
   401→			info.IsTaskCheckpoint = true
   402→			info.MetadataDir = taskMetadataDir
   403→			info.ToolUseID = extractToolUseIDFromPath(taskMetadataDir)
   404→		} else {
   405→			metadataDir, found := paths.ParseMetadataTrailer(c.Message)
   406→			if found {
   407→				info.MetadataDir = metadataDir
   408→			}
   409→		}
   410→
   411→		results = append(results, info)
   412→
   413→		if len(results) >= limit {
   414→			return errStop
   415→		}
   416→		return nil
   417→	})
   418→
   419→	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, errStop) {
   420→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("error iterating commits: %w", err)
   421→	}
   422→
   423→	return results, nil
   424→}

   495→// buildTreeWithChanges builds a git tree with the given changes.
   496→// metadataDir is the relative path for git tree entries, metadataDirAbs is the absolute path
   497→// for filesystem operations (needed when CLI is run from a subdirectory).
   498→func (s *GitStore) buildTreeWithChanges(
   499→	baseTreeHash plumbing.Hash,
   500→	modifiedFiles, deletedFiles []string,
   501→	metadataDir, metadataDirAbs string,
   502→) (plumbing.Hash, error) {
   503→	// Get repo root for resolving file paths
   504→	// This is critical because fileExists() and createBlobFromFile() use os.Stat()
   505→	// which resolves relative to CWD. The modifiedFiles are repo-relative paths,
   506→	// so we must resolve them against repo root, not CWD.
   507→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   508→	if err != nil {
   509→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to get repo root: %w", err)
   510→	}
   511→
   512→	// Get the base tree
   513→	baseTree, err := s.repo.TreeObject(baseTreeHash)
   514→	if err != nil {
   515→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to get base tree: %w", err)
   516→	}
   517→
   518→	// Flatten existing tree
   519→	entries := make(map[string]object.TreeEntry)
   520→	if err := FlattenTree(s.repo, baseTree, "", entries); err != nil {
   521→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to flatten base tree: %w", err)
   522→	}
   523→
   524→	// Remove deleted files
   525→	for _, file := range deletedFiles {
   526→		delete(entries, file)
   527→	}
   528→
   529→	// Add/update modified files
   530→	for _, file := range modifiedFiles {
   531→		// Resolve path relative to repo root for filesystem operations
   532→		absPath := filepath.Join(repoRoot, file)
   533→		if !fileExists(absPath) {
   534→			delete(entries, file)
   535→			continue
   536→		}
   537→
   538→		blobHash, mode, err := createBlobFromFile(s.repo, absPath)
   539→		if err != nil {
   540→			// Skip files that can't be staged (may have been deleted since detection)
   541→			continue
   542→		}
   543→
   544→		entries[file] = object.TreeEntry{
   545→			Name: file,
   546→			Mode: mode,
   547→			Hash: blobHash,
   548→		}
   549→	}
   550→
   551→	// Add metadata directory files
   552→	if metadataDir != "" && metadataDirAbs != "" {
   553→		if err := addDirectoryToEntriesWithAbsPath(s.repo, metadataDirAbs, metadataDir, entries); err != nil {
   554→			return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to add metadata directory: %w", err)
   555→		}
   556→	}
   557→
   558→	// Build tree
   559→	return BuildTreeFromEntries(s.repo, entries)
   560→}

   599→// FlattenTree recursively flattens a tree into a map of full paths to entries.
   600→func FlattenTree(repo *git.Repository, tree *object.Tree, prefix string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) error {
   601→	for _, entry := range tree.Entries {
   602→		fullPath := entry.Name
   603→		if prefix != "" {
   604→			fullPath = prefix + "/" + entry.Name
   605→		}
   606→
   607→		if entry.Mode == filemode.Dir {
   608→			// Recurse into subtree
   609→			subtree, err := repo.TreeObject(entry.Hash)
   610→			if err != nil {
   611→				return fmt.Errorf("failed to get subtree %s: %w", fullPath, err)
   612→			}
   613→			if err := FlattenTree(repo, subtree, fullPath, entries); err != nil {
   614→				return err
   615→			}
   616→		} else {
   617→			entries[fullPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   618→				Name: fullPath,
   619→				Mode: entry.Mode,
   620→				Hash: entry.Hash,
   621→			}
   622→		}
   623→	}
   624→	return nil
   625→}

   633→// createBlobFromFile creates a blob object from a file in the working directory.
   634→func createBlobFromFile(repo *git.Repository, filePath string) (plumbing.Hash, filemode.FileMode, error) {
   635→	info, err := os.Stat(filePath)
   636→	if err != nil {
   637→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to stat file: %w", err)
   638→	}
   639→
   640→	// Determine file mode
   641→	mode := filemode.Regular
   642→	if info.Mode()&0o111 != 0 {
   643→		mode = filemode.Executable
   644→	}
   645→	if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
   646→		mode = filemode.Symlink
   647→	}
   648→
   649→	// Read file contents
   650→	content, err := os.ReadFile(filePath) //nolint:gosec // filePath comes from walking the repository
   651→	if err != nil {
   652→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to read file: %w", err)
   653→	}
   654→
   655→	// Create blob object
   656→	obj := repo.Storer.NewEncodedObject()
   657→	obj.SetType(plumbing.BlobObject)
   658→	obj.SetSize(int64(len(content)))
   659→
   660→	writer, err := obj.Writer()
   661→	if err != nil {
   662→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to get object writer: %w", err)
   663→	}
   664→
   665→	_, err = writer.Write(content)
   666→	if err != nil {
   667→		_ = writer.Close()
   668→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to write blob content: %w", err)
   669→	}
   670→	if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
   671→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to close blob writer: %w", err)
   672→	}
   673→
   674→	hash, err := repo.Storer.SetEncodedObject(obj)
   675→	if err != nil {
   676→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to store blob object: %w", err)
   677→	}
   678→
   679→	return hash, mode, nil
   680→}

   682→// addDirectoryToEntriesWithAbsPath recursively adds all files in a directory to the entries map.
   683→func addDirectoryToEntriesWithAbsPath(repo *git.Repository, dirPathAbs, dirPathRel string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) error {
   684→	err := filepath.Walk(dirPathAbs, func(path string, info os.FileInfo, err error) error {
   685→		if err != nil {
   686→			return err
   687→		}
   688→		if info.IsDir() {
   689→			return nil
   690→		}
   691→
   692→		// Calculate relative path within the directory, then join with dirPathRel for tree entry
   693→		relWithinDir, err := filepath.Rel(dirPathAbs, path)
   694→		if err != nil {
   695→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to get relative path for %s: %w", path, err)
   696→		}
   697→
   698→		blobHash, mode, err := createBlobFromFile(repo, path)
   699→		if err != nil {
   700→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to create blob for %s: %w", path, err)
   701→		}
   702→
   703→		treePath := filepath.Join(dirPathRel, relWithinDir)
   704→		entries[treePath] = object.TreeEntry{
   705→			Name: treePath,
   706→			Mode: mode,
   707→			Hash: blobHash,
   708→		}
   709→		return nil
   710→	})
   711→	if err != nil {
   712→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to walk directory %s: %w", dirPathAbs, err)
   713→	}
   714→	return nil
   715→}

   717→// treeNode represents a node in our tree structure.
   718→type treeNode struct {
   719→	entries map[string]*treeNode // subdirectories
   720→	files   []object.TreeEntry   // files in this directory

   723→// BuildTreeFromEntries builds a proper git tree structure from flattened file entries.
   724→// Exported for use by strategy package (push_common.go, session_test.go)
   725→func BuildTreeFromEntries(repo *git.Repository, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) (plumbing.Hash, error) {
   726→	// Build a tree structure
   727→	root := &treeNode{
   728→		entries: make(map[string]*treeNode),
   729→		files:   []object.TreeEntry{},
   730→	}
   731→
   732→	// Insert all entries into the tree structure
   733→	for fullPath, entry := range entries {
   734→		parts := strings.Split(fullPath, "/")
   735→		insertIntoTree(root, parts, entry)
   736→	}
   737→
   738→	// Recursively build tree objects from bottom up
   739→	return buildTreeObject(repo, root)
   740→}
   741→
   742→// insertIntoTree inserts a file entry into the tree structure.
   743→func insertIntoTree(node *treeNode, pathParts []string, entry object.TreeEntry) {
   744→	if len(pathParts) == 1 {
   745→		// This is a file in the current directory
   746→		node.files = append(node.files, object.TreeEntry{
   747→			Name: pathParts[0],
   748→			Mode: entry.Mode,
   749→			Hash: entry.Hash,
   750→		})
   751→		return
   752→	}
   753→
   754→	// This is in a subdirectory
   755→	dirName := pathParts[0]
   756→	if node.entries[dirName] == nil {
   757→		node.entries[dirName] = &treeNode{
   758→			entries: make(map[string]*treeNode),
   759→			files:   []object.TreeEntry{},
   760→		}
   761→	}
   762→	insertIntoTree(node.entries[dirName], pathParts[1:], entry)
   763→}

   765→// buildTreeObject recursively builds tree objects from a treeNode.
   766→func buildTreeObject(repo *git.Repository, node *treeNode) (plumbing.Hash, error) {
   767→	var treeEntries []object.TreeEntry
   768→
   769→	// Add files
   770→	treeEntries = append(treeEntries, node.files...)
   771→
   772→	// Recursively build subtrees
   773→	for name, subnode := range node.entries {
   774→		subHash, err := buildTreeObject(repo, subnode)
   775→		if err != nil {
   776→			return plumbing.ZeroHash, err
   777→		}
   778→		treeEntries = append(treeEntries, object.TreeEntry{
   779→			Name: name,
   780→			Mode: filemode.Dir,
   781→			Hash: subHash,
   782→		})
   783→	}
   784→
   785→	// Sort entries (git requires sorted entries)
   786→	sortTreeEntries(treeEntries)
   787→
   788→	// Create tree object
   789→	tree := &object.Tree{Entries: treeEntries}
   790→
   791→	obj := repo.Storer.NewEncodedObject()
   792→	if err := tree.Encode(obj); err != nil {
   793→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to encode tree: %w", err)
   794→	}
   795→
   796→	hash, err := repo.Storer.SetEncodedObject(obj)
   797→	if err != nil {
   798→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to store tree: %w", err)
   799→	}
   800→
   801→	return hash, nil
   802→}

   804→// sortTreeEntries sorts tree entries in git's required order.
   805→// Git sorts tree entries by name, with directories having a trailing /
   806→func sortTreeEntries(entries []object.TreeEntry) {
   807→	sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
   808→		nameI := entries[i].Name
   809→		nameJ := entries[j].Name
   810→		if entries[i].Mode == filemode.Dir {
   811→			nameI += "/"
   812→		}
   813→		if entries[j].Mode == filemode.Dir {
   814→			nameJ += "/"
